name: sheet-music-analysis
description: Harmonic analysis of sheet music, drawn on the engraved score.

capabilities: Analyse harmony in a MusicXML score
Draw the analysis on the engraved page
defaultPrompt: Analyse the harmony of bars 1-8 of this score.
Show me the phrases and cadences in this piece.
How do the voices move in bars 5-8?

positive.description: Full analysis of an attached score
positive.prompt: Analyse the harmony of bars 1-8 of this.
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows the engraved bars 1-8 with Roman numerals, coloured chord-function bands, boxed cadences and numbered circles, with PNG and PDF links, followed by a short commentary.
The same bars redrawn with chords and bands only (view harmony).
Bars 9-16 annotated in a card, with a commentary.

positive.prompt: Show the phrase structure of bars 1-16.
positive.expected_behavior: Bars 1-16 with phrase brackets and cadences (view form).

positive.prompt: I have a MusicXML score I'd like analysed.
positive.expected_behavior: A card with a file button. After the reviewer picks the sample file, the card confirms it and asks which bars; typing "Analyse bars 1-8" gives the analysis as in the first case.

negative.description: General music theory question with no score: answered from general knowledge, no tool call.
negative.prompt: What is a Neapolitan sixth chord?

negative.description: Audio instead of a score: the app needs MusicXML, so no tool call; the reply explains that and suggests exporting MusicXML from notation software.
negative.prompt: Here's an MP3 of my piece, can you analyse it?

negative.description: Editing or rewriting music is outside the app, which only analyses: no tool call.
negative.prompt: Transpose this score to D major and send me the new file.

publication.release_notes: First release: Roman-numeral analysis, cadences, phrases, non-chord tones and voice leading drawn on the engraved score, with harmony, voice-leading and form views.
